== Earlier official Set 0 slips, 13 November 2026 ==
The 2016 official PDF prints “up to 15 cards” and “play a Defensive Shield”. The 2017 official PDF prints “any number of Defensive Shields” and “play a card”, with an E mark. Both preserved PDF payloads were verified against the recovered original files by SHA-256. These capture dates establish publication by those dates, not initial release dates.

The 2017 slip and 2018 full-card image have the same game-text words. They are documented as different published image presentations: lower cutout versus full face. The 2018 and 2022 images both actually print “play a card”; the corrected transcriptions were retained. Their existing Talk histories follow their moved articles at [[Talk:Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Talk:Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata 3)]].

The official PDF slips reproduce the lower game-text panel, Starting Effect label, Set 0 icon, errata-mark state and bottom caption. Upper-face destiny, lore, title styling, art and rarity are inherited from the underlying [[Knowledge And Defense]] and are not reproduced by either partial slip. No fan full-face scan was reassigned. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
